verdict.rationale: Orb's docs say it automatically calculates recognized revenue in line with ASC 606 [orb-docs-22]. It also tracks recognized, deferred and accrued revenue from billing data [orb-docs-7, orb-docs-4] and offers managed daily exports to financial systems [orb-docs-12], which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: any mention of IFRS 15, explicit deferred-revenue schedule detail, evidence of audit-ready recognition reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
